title: AI, Customer Experience, and Knowledge Management Leaders Convene at eGain Solve26 in Chicago
body_markdown:
## Two-day conference features keynotes, customer showcases, hands-on masterclasses, and industry tracks for Healthcare and for Banking, Financial Services & Insurance


**Sunnyvale, CA (October 8, 2026):** eGain Corporation (NASDAQ:[EGAN](https://www.nasdaq.com/market-activity/stocks/egan) ), the AI knowledge platform for customer engagement and employee productivity, today unveiled the full agenda and speaker lineup for Solve26, its premier conference for AI, customer experience (CX), and knowledge management (KM) leaders, taking place next week, October 13–14, 2026, at the Hyatt Regency O’Hare in Chicago. The finalized program brings together practitioners, executives, and industry experts around a single theme: building the trusted knowledge foundations that enterprise AI depends on.


Across two days, Solve26 will feature keynotes, customer showcases, hands-on masterclasses, and technical deep-dives. Day 1 will center on keynotes and customer stories — including sessions such as “Knowledge is the Instruction for AI” and the role of ontologies in LLM automation — while Day 2 will turn to practitioner tracks including AI Knowledge Ops, Agentic Studio and AI Agents, and AI Knowledge Engineering, plus industry-specific programming for Healthcare and for Banking, Financial Services & Insurance.


Featured speakers will include eGain chairman and CEO Ashu Roy, Frank Coyle of UC Berkeley, alongside customer leaders from Country Financial, Healthfirst, Rogue Credit Union, Worldpay/Global Payments, Florida Blue, and Philip Morris International, who will share how they are operationalizing knowledge for AI across customer service and operations.


“Every enterprise is now investing in AI, and the hardest part isn’t the model — it’s the trusted knowledge underneath it,” said Ashu Roy, chairman and CEO of eGain. “Solve26 brings together the people doing this work so they can learn what AI-ready knowledge really takes from the organizations that are already getting it right.”


Day 1 will also feature a session by Amy Machado, Research Director at IDC, on enterprise knowledge management maturity. In the underlying study of 520 organizations, 95% are now “evaluating, piloting, or actively running AI within their KM processes,” yet the payoff is uneven — “on every business impact metric … leaders report roughly 2X improvement” over laggards.


Source: IDC White Paper, sponsored by eGain, The Knowledge Foundation That Unlocks Enterprise AI Success, Doc **#US60926** , October 2026.


The full agenda and registration are available at[https://www.egain.com/egain-solve-26-chicago/](https://www.egain.com/egain-solve-26-chicago/) .


### **About eGain**


eGain is a leading provider of AI-powered knowledge management and customer experience automation solutions and was named a Leader in the Gartner inaugural Magic Quadrant for Customer Service Knowledge Management Systems. With over 25 years of experience in knowledge management, eGain helps enterprises unify siloed content, automate trusted knowledge workflows, and deliver measurable AI-ROI through proven frameworks and methods. Global 2000 companies across industries rely on eGain to transform customer service, improve employee productivity, reduce costs, and accelerate AI adoption. Visit[www.eGain.com](https://www.egain.com/) for more information.
